title: Correa–Goemans bipartite proportional-factors question
statement: Let G=(V,E) be a finite bipartite graph, and let c₁,…,cₖ be positive real numbers with sum one. Then E can be partitioned into E₁,…,Eₖ so that, for every vertex v and every i, ⌊cᵢd_E(v)⌋≤d_{Eᵢ}(v)≤⌈cᵢd_E(v)⌉.

counterexample.description: A finite simple nonregular bipartite graph and three distinct positive rational weights summing to one for which exhaustive edge assignment finds no partition satisfying every rounded degree target.
